a: Yes. You can open a joint account under Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: Where Do I Open A Bank Account Under PMJDY?
a: You can open a PMJDY account at any bank branch on Core Banking Solutions (CBS) or at a BC outlet of such Banks.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: Can I Link My Mobile Number With My Bank Account Opened Under PMJDY?
a: Yes. You can link your mobile number with your bank account. You can do so by contacting your bank where you have opened your bank account under PMJDY. Bank will enter your mobile number in the CBS system based on the information provided by you.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: What Is A Small Account or Chota Khata under PMJDY ?
a: A "Small Account" or "Chota Account" can be opened in case of non availability of Officially Valid Documents (OVDs). These accounts would be valid normally for a period of twelve months. Thereafter, such accounts would be allowed to a continue for a further period of twelve more months, if the account-holder provides a document showing that he/she has applied for any of the Officially Valid Document, within 12 months of opening the small account.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: Does The PMJDY Scheme Offer Accidental Insurance Cover ?
a: All PMJDY Accounts are provided with a free Rupay Debit Card with inbuilt accidental insurance cover of Rs.2 lakh (Rs 1 lakh for accounts opened before 28.08.2018).

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: Is Overdraft/Loan Facility Available Under PMJDY?
a: Overdraft facility (SBOD) upto Rs. 10,000/- will be available to one account holder of PMJDY per household after 6 months of satisfactory conduct of the account, subject to fulfilment of eligibility criteria.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: Is It Possible To Extend My Loan Amount Taken Against My PMJDY Bank Account?
a: Yes, it is possible to extend your loan/overdraft taken against your PMJDY Bank Account. Bank may increase this amount, provided you make your repayments on time subject to a maximum amount of Rs. 10,000/-.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: How Much Processing Fees Do I Need To Pay For Processing The Loan Against My Account?
a: There is no processing fees.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: What About Mobile Banking Facility? Does My Account Opened Under The PMJDY Scheme Provide Mobile Banking?
a: Yes.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: Is A Minor Eligible To Open A Bank Account Under PMJDY?
a: Yes. A minor is eligible to open a bank account under PMJDY under guardianship.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: Are Minors Eligible To Receive RuPay Cards Offered Under PMJDY Bank Accounts?
a: Yes. Minors are eligible to get RuPay Cards. They can use the card 4 times in a month for cash withdrawal.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: What Are The Documents Required For Opening A Bank Account Under PMJDY?
a: The following documents are required - | - AADHAAR | - Government ID proofs (Voter Card/PAN Card/Ration card) | - Permanent Address proof (Passport/Driving License/Electricity Bill/Telephone Bill/Water Bill) | - Passport size photograph | - Filled and Signed PMJDY Account opening form | - Any other document as notified by the Central Government in consultation with the Regulator.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: What If I Don't' Have A Valid Residential Proof? Will I Be Able To Open A Bank Account Under PMJDY?
a: Yes. You can still open a bank account. What you have to do is to provide an identity proof issued by the Government of India.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: Can A RuPay Card Be Availed By Illiterate Account Holders?
a: Yes. It can be availed by illiterate account holders as well. RuPay Card is a kind of debit card issued for the purpose of ATM withdrawal and making PoS payments. The concerned bank officials will educate the illiterate RuPay Card holders as to how to use this card and keep it safe at the time of card issuance.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: Will I Get A Cheque Book Against My Bank Account?
a: The accounts can be opened under PMJDY with Zero balance. Cheque book(s) are not a mandatory feature of PMJDY A/cs. Banks can offer additional services including Cheque Books as per the norms specified by each Bank. One can avail the same by meeting the criteria.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: How Much Interest Do I Receive On My Savings Account Opened Under PMJDY?
a: The applicable rate of interest is equal to interest on saving account.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: Do Banks Charge Account Opening Fees For Opening An Account Under PMJDY?
a: Banks do not charge any fees while opening PMJDY account.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: Is The Bank Account Opened Under PMJDY Transferrable? What If I Want To Transfer My Account from One City To Another Or One State To Other?
a: Yes. You can easily transfer your PMJDY account from one city/state to another as all banks offering bank accounts have core banking solutions (intra-bank). You can do this by simply requesting the bank.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: What Is a Bank Mitr?
a: Bank Mitr is a Business Correspondent who provides banking services at select locations. The Bank Mitr represents the bank and helps it expand its outreach. He offers banking services at areas where establishing a brick and mortar branch is not feasible. Retired Bank Employees, Retired Teachers, Retired Government Employees and Ex-Servicemen can join as a Bank Mitr.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: What Minimum Balance Do I Need To Put In My Bank Account?
a: There is no requirement of minimum balance .

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: What Is a PoS Machine?
a: It is a small device installed at business centres to help you enjoy cashless purchases. PoS stands for Point of Sale.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: I Am An Existing PMJDY Customer Of A Particular Bank And I Want To Open Another Bank Account Under PMJDY, Am I Eligible?
a: No. A person can have only one PMJDY Account . However, if he/she wants to open a Basic Saving Bank Account or a PMJDY Account in other bank, the existing Account will have to be closed within 30 days of opening an Account in the other bank.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: What Is The Exit Age Determined By This Scheme?
a: There is no exit age under this Scheme.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: What If I Don't Have Any Documents? How Will I Open An Account Then?
a: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) vide its Press Release dated 26.08.2014 has clarified as under : | "Those persons who do not have any of the 'officially valid documents' can open "Small Accounts" with banks' branch". | A "Small Account" can be opened on the basis of a self-attested photograph and putting his/her signatures or thumb print in the presence of an official(s) of the bank. Such accounts have limitations regarding : | i. aggregate credits (not more than Rupees one lac in a year), | ii. aggregate withdrawals (not more than Rupees ten thousand in a month), and | iii. balance in the account

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
q: Can I Change My Address In The Bank Account?
a: Yes. You can change your address by providing a self-declaration certificate or submitting supporting documents.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
q: How do I pay the premium for PMJJBY?
a: The premium will be deducted from the account holder's bank / Post office account through 'auto debit' facility.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
q: What is the validity of the insurance cover in PMJJBY?
a: Coverage under PMJJBY is valid for one year from 1st June to 31st May on payment of annual premium.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
q: Is delayed enrolment for prospective cover possible under this scheme?
a: Yes. | Delayed enrolment for prospective cover is possible on payment of premium as described below - | a) For enrolment in June, July and August - Full Annual Premium of Rs.436/- is payable. | b) For enrolment in September, October, and November -premium of Rs. 342/- is payable | c) For enrolment in December, January and February -premium of Rs. 228/- is payable. | d) For enrolment in March, April and May -premium of Rs. 114/- is payable.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
q: If I decide to exit the scheme, is there any possibility that I can rejoin at a later point of time?
a: Yes. | One can enroll again under the same conditions of eligibility stipulated in the Scheme.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
q: Who will offer / administer the scheme?
a: The scheme would be offered / administered through Insurance companies willing to offer the product with necessary approvals on similar terms, in collaboration with participating Banks. Participating banks will be free to engage any such insurance company for implementing the scheme for their subscribers.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
q: What is the minimum eligibility to subscribe to PMJJBY?
a: All savings bank account holders in the age 18 to 50 years in participating banks will be entitled to join. | In case of multiple bank accounts held by an individual in one or different banks, the person would be eligible to join the scheme through one saving bank account only.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
q: Who would be the Master policy holder for the scheme?
a: Participating Banks/ Post Offices will be the Master policy holders.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
q: Are NRIs eligible for coverage under PMJJBY?
a: Any NRI having an eligible bank account with a bank branch located in India is eligible for purchase of PMJJBY cover subject to fulfilment of the terms and conditions relating to the scheme. However, in case a claim arises, the claim benefit will be paid to the beneficiary/ nominee only in Indian currency.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
q: Does the PMJJBY cover death resulting from natural calamities such as earthquake, flood and other convulsions of nature? What about coverage from suicide / murder?
a: Yes, all these events are covered under PMJJBY.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
q: What are the changes in the terms of insurance coverage applicable to new subscribers?
a: For subscribers enrolling for the first time on or after 1st June 2016, insurance benefit shall not be available for death (due to any cause other than accident) occurring during the first 30 days from the date of enrolment into the scheme. Death due to accidental causes will be covered from day one of insurance coverage.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
q: How do I access the Claim Form for PMJJBY?
a: The claim forms can be accessed from the link - https://www.jansuraksha.gov.in/Files/PMJJBY/English/ClaimForm.pdf

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan vikas karyakram
q: What is the Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK)?
a: PMJVK is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme of the Ministry of Minority Affairs that aims to develop infrastructure and provide basic amenities in Minority Concentrated Areas (MCAs). The scheme focuses on education, health, skill development, housing, and community assets to ensure inclusive growth of minority communities.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan vikas karyakram
q: Who can benefit from PMJVK?
a: The benefits of PMJVK are area-based and cover all communities residing in Minority Concentrated Areas (MCAs). However, the focus is on improving living conditions for notified minority communities — Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Parsis, and Jains.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan vikas karyakram
q: How are projects selected under PMJVK?
a: Projects are proposed by State or UT Minority Welfare Departments and District Authorities based on local development needs through State Level Committees constituted at the State level. These proposals are examined by the Screening Committee and then put before the Empowered Committee at the Ministry of Minority Affairs to consideration and approval depending upon the criteria set in the guidelines of PMJVK scheme.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan vikas karyakram
q: Can individuals directly apply for benefits under PMJVK?
a: No, PMJVK is not an individual-benefit or cash-transfer scheme. It is implemented through State and District authorities to create community infrastructure and public amenities.

n: Pradhan Mantri Jan vikas karyakram
q: What types of projects are funded under PMJVK?
a: PMJVK supports construction of schools, hostels, health centres, community halls, colleges, hospitals, sports stadiums drinking water facilities, skill development centres, etc. in Minority Concentrated Areas.

n: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
q: What is "Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PMKMY)"?
a: PMKMY is a voluntary and contributory pension scheme launched by the Government of India to provide old-age security to small and marginal farmers.

n: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
q: Who is eligible to join PMKMY?
a: Small and marginal farmers aged between 18 and 40 years with cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares are eligible to enroll in the scheme.

n: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
q: What pension benefit is provided under PMKMY?
a: After attaining the age of 60 years, beneficiaries receive a guaranteed monthly pension of ₹3,000/-.

n: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
q: Who is eligible to join PMKMY?
a: Small and marginal farmers aged between 18 and 40 years with cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares are eligible to enroll in the scheme.

n: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
q: What pension benefit is provided under PMKMY?
a: After attaining the age of 60 years, beneficiaries receive a guaranteed monthly pension of ₹3,000/-.

n: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
q: How much contribution is required from farmers?
a: The contribution depends on the age at entry and ranges from ₹55/- to ₹200/- per month.

n: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
q: Does the Government contribute to the scheme?
a: Yes, the Government of India makes an equal matching contribution to the farmer’s contribution.

n: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
q: What happens if the beneficiary dies during the scheme period?
a: If the beneficiary dies before the pension age, the spouse can continue the scheme by paying the remaining contributions.

n: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
q: What happens if the beneficiary dies after starting pension?
a: After the death of the pensioner, the spouse is entitled to receive 50% of the pension as a family pension.

n: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
q: Can a beneficiary exit the scheme?
a: Yes, beneficiaries can voluntarily exit the scheme before the age of 60 years under specified conditions.

n: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
q: What happens if the beneficiary exits before 10 years?
a: If the beneficiary exits before completing 10 years, only the farmer’s contribution along with savings bank interest will be returned.

n: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
q: What happens if the beneficiary exits after 10 years but before 60 years?
a: If the exit is after 10 years, the beneficiary can receive either the farmer’s contribution with interest or the accumulated pension fund, whichever is higher.

n: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
q: How can farmers enroll in the scheme?
a: Farmers can enroll through Common Service Centres (CSCs).

n: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
q: Can farmers receiving PM-KISAN benefits join PMKMY?
a: Yes, farmers receiving PM-KISAN benefits can also join PMKMY, and their PM-KISAN benefit can be used for contribution payment.

n: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop
q: What does this scheme focus on?
a: The scheme mainly focuses on enhancing water use efficiency at the farm level through Micro Irrigation (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation System). Besides, it also supports micro-level water storage, and water conservation/management activities (Other Interventions) to supplement source creation for Micro Irrigation.

n: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop
q: Which Ministry has Launched the Scheme?
a: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India

n: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop
q: When was this scheme launched?
a: The scheme was launched on 1st July 2015

n: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop
q: What are the components of Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)?
a: It comprises four components, namely (i) Accelerated Irrigation Benefit Programme (AIBP), (ii) Har Khet Ko Paani, (iii) Watershed Development (iv) Per Drop More Crop.

n: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop
q: Is it a centrally sponsored scheme?
a: Yes, it is a centrally sponsored scheme.

n: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop
q: What is the pattern of assistance payable to the beneficiary under the micro irrigation scheme?
a: The pattern of assistance payable to the beneficiary under the micro irrigation scheme will be 55% for small and marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers which will be met by both the Central Government and State Government in the ratio of 60:40 for all states except the North Eastern and Himalayan.

n: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop
q: What is the percentage of share of the Central Government and the North Eastern States?
a: The ratio of sharing is 90:10.

n: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop
q: What is the funding pattern for the Union Territories under the scheme?
a: For the Union Territories, the funding pattern is 100% grant by the Central Government.

n: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop
q: How will farmers be benefited from the scheme?
a: Under the scheme, farmers may get support for their farm ponds and means of micro-irrigation like sprinkler irrigation & drip irrigation equipment. Besides, they may also get training on methods of crop management & water harvesting/management through assured irrigation.

n: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop
q: Who is eligible for the scheme?
a: All the farmers of the State & Union Territory are eligible to take the benefits of this scheme.

n: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop
q: For how many hectares can farmers avail of financial assistance under the scheme?
a: The financial assistance for the installation of a micro irrigation system will be limited to the overall ceiling of 5 hectares per beneficiary.

n: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop
q: How will the farmers receive financial assistance under the scheme?
a: The scheme is to be implemented through the mechanism of Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

n: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop
q: Is an Aadhaar card mandatory for the beneficiary to avail of the benefits of the scheme?
a: Yes, the Aadhaar details of the beneficiary are required to access the benefit of the programme.

n: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop
q: Which is the nodal department for implementing the PMKSY (Per Drop More Crop)?
a: State Agriculture Department may be the Nodal Department for the implementation of PMKSY (Per Drop More Crop).

n: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop
q: How will the state government identify the nodal departments?
a: The state government is free to identify dedicated implementing agencies/departments for the implementation of Per Drop More Crop based on the established institutional setup and mandate of the department. All communication between the Ministry of Agriculture (MoA) and the State Government would be preferable with and through the nodal department.

n: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop
q: How can I apply under the scheme?
a: The farmers, based on the requirement of their field & region, may contact their Block/District Agriculture Office through respective Gram Panchayat. Further, the farmer may also contact the Agriculture Officer of their Block/District or call Kisan Call Centre (Toll-Free No. 1800-180-1551).

a: Yes, you are eligible for the scheme.

n: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
q: I am Adult women belong to Forest Dweller. Am I eligible to PMUY scheme?
a: Yes, you are eligible for the scheme.

n: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
q: If my D.O.B is not mention at ration card then how can prove that I am adult women?
a: You can use Aadhaar Card to validate your age.

n: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
q: If my Mobile number is not linked with Aadhaar card, Can I apply for PMUY?
a: Yes, you shall be eligible for application process.

n: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
q: What if someone doesn't have an email?
a: You can also apply without email.

n: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
q: If I am a migrant family, can I apply for the scheme?
a: Yes, But You fill the Annexure 1 and upload during application process.

n: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
q: I do not have any bank account number in my name can I give my husband's bank account number?
a: No, There should be a bank account in the name of the applicant.

n: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
q: Who is the eligible beneficiary under ujjwala 2.0?
a: An adult woman belonging to a poor household and not having LPG connection in her household, will be eligible under UJJWALA 2.0. The beneficiaries should belong to any of the following categories: | - Eligible as per SECC 2011 list | - Belongs to SC/ST households, be a beneficiary of Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY), Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY), Forest dwellers, Most Backward Classes (MBC), Tea and Ex-Tea Garden Tribes, People residing in riverIslands (Beneficiary will submit supporting document) | - If she is not falling in the above 2 categories, then she can stake her claim to be a benefic

n: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
q: Which Documents are mandatory to be submitted by applicant for enrolment under ujjwala 2.0?
a: The applicant must provide following documents: | - KYC as per the standard format carrying photograph of the applicant and duly signed. | - POI (Proof of Identity) | - POA (Proof of Address) | - Aadhaar copy of Applicant, | - Aadhaar copy of all adult family members as mentioned in Ration Card or similar document. | - Bank account details of the applicant | - Ration card or any other family document issued by State Govt. /District | administration detailing household composition (such as Bhamashah Card in Rajasthan and Samagra Id in MP, Parivar Register of Uttar Pradesh, Parivar Pehchan Patra

n: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
q: If customer possess aadhaar card and connection to be released in the same address as mentioned in aadhaar card, can it be used as the POI and POA document?
a: In case the Aadhaar card is having the address at which connection is to be released, it can be used both as the POI and POA.

n: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
q: What doccument can be produced as proof of Identity (pOI) and Proof of address( POA)?
a: - Aadhaar Card of applicant will only be considered as Proof of Identity (POI) for applicants of all states except Assam and Meghalaya. | - This would also serve the purpose of Proof of Address (POA) if the current address of applicant is same as per her Aadhaar. | - In case, applicant address is different from that mentioned in Aadhaar card, then she can submit any other documents for POA as listed in the Annexure - A | - For Assam and Meghalaya, where Aadhaar is not mandatory, applicant can submit, any other Proof of Identity as given in the below table. | - In case of Migrants, they can sub

n: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
q: How can one apply for LPG connection under Ujjwala 2.0?
a: Applicant can apply both online and offline. | - Online - Customer can enroll through online application, or she can also contact her nearest CSC Centre for submitting the online application. | - Offline - Customer can enroll by directly submitting the application at the distributorship.

n: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
q: What are the mandatory documents to be uploaded by the distributor for submission of KYC under ujjwala 2.0?
a: The following documents are to be uploaded by the distributor: | - Proof of Identity (POI (any one as per list in the application form) | - Proof of Address (POA) (any one as per list in the application form) | - Aadhaar of Applicant (Aadhaar is not mandatory for Assam & Meghalaya, however Ration Card issued by State Government is required). | - Ration Card or any other family document issued by State Govt. /District administration detailing family composition or Self Declaration of Family for migrants as per Annexure-I | - 14-point declaration duly signed by applicant as per standard format g

n: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
q: If the applicant is unable to submit aadhaar card of any adult family member whose name is appearing in ration card or equivalent document issued by state department, will she be enrolled under ujjwala 2.0?
a: Suchbeneficiaries cannotbeenrolled.TheDistributor has to make efforts in getting the Aadhaar enrolment of such adults in the family and show receipt of same, applicant can be enrolled under UJJWALA 2.0. Exemption will be provided only in case of death of any adult family member or separation of any family member due to marriage etc. with submission of documentary proof like death certificate, marriage certificate etc

n: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
q: What is the criterion to ascertain a poor household under ujjwala 2.0?
a: The 14-point declaration submitted by the applicant is the basic criteria to consider it as eligible Poor household under UJJWALA 2.0. Thus, it is mandatory for all applicants.

n: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
q: What type of ration card needd to be submitted by applicant?
a: As Ration Card is only for the purpose of identifying the family Composition of the beneficiary any type of Ration card either APL or BPL will be considered.

n: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
q: Whether a connection can be given to a female who is claiming to be single member in the household or other members of the family who are minors?
a: Yes, if there are supporting documents viz.Ration Card confirming single adult member in the family. In case additional adult members are shown in the Ration Card, then Death certificate in case of the deceased family member or marriage certificate for member moved out of the family should be attached.

n: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
q: PMUY connection can be released to poor household with no female adult member?
a: No. PMUY connection can be released in the name of adult female member of the Poor household only.

n: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
q: Is aadhaar Authentication (E-KYC) is mandatory for connections enrolled under ujjwala 2.0? if so, how it is carried out?
a: Yes. Aadhaar authentication will be carried out through Biometric or Mobile OTP based, for the connections enrolled under Ujjwala 2.0. Aadhaar authentication is optional only in the state of Assam and Meghalaya.

n: PM Vishwakarma
q: What is Pradhan Mantri Vishwakarma Scheme?
a: PM Vishwakarma is a Central Sector Scheme launched by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises to provide holistic and end-to-end support to artisans and craftspeople through access to collateral free credit, skill training, modern tools, incentive for digital transactions and market linkage support.

n: PM Vishwakarma
q: Which category of trades are covered in the scheme?
a: Carpenter (Suthar), Boat Maker, Armourer, Blacksmith (Lohar), Hammer and Tool Kit Maker, Locksmith, Goldsmith (Sunar), Potter (Kumhaar), Sculptor (Moortikar)/ stone carver / Stone breaker, Cobbler (Charmkar)/ Shoesmith/ Footwear artisan, Mason (Raajmistri), Basket Maker/ Basket Waver: Mat maker/ Coir Weaver/ Broom maker, Doll & Toy Maker (Traditional), Barber (Naai), Garland Maker (Malakaar), Washerman (Dhobi), Tailor (Darzi) and Fishing Net Maker.

n: PM Vishwakarma
q: What are the key components of PM Vishwakarma?
a: The key components of PM Vishwakarma Scheme are: | - Recognition: PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card | - Skill Upgradation | - Toolkit Incentive | - Credit Support | - Incentive for Digital Transactions | - Marketing Support

n: PM Vishwakarma
q: What are the eligibility criteria of the Scheme?
a: - An artisan or crafts person working with hands and tools and engaged in one of the above family-based traditional trades, in unorganized sector on self-employment basis, shall be eligible for registration under PM Vishwakarma. | - The minimum age of the beneficiary should be 18 years on the date of registration. | - The beneficiary should be engaged in the trade concerned on the date of registration and should not have availed loans under similar credit-based schemes of Central Government or State Government for self-employment/ business development, e.g. PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, Mudra, in the pa

n: PM Vishwakarma
q: How to avail benefits under the Scheme ?
a: Any individual willing to avail the benefits of the Scheme, may register on the portal www.pmvishwakarma.gov.in.

n: PM Vishwakarma
q: Which documents are required to be provided during registration on PM Vishwakarma portal?
a: Aadhaar, Mobile number, Bank details, Ration card mandatory for the registration.

n: PM Vishwakarma
q: Which lending institutions can provide credit under the Scheme?
a: Scheduled Commercial Banks, Regional Rural Banks, Small Finance Banks, Cooperative Banks, Non-Banking Finance Companies and Micro Finance Institutions are eligible to lend under this Scheme.

n: PM Vishwakarma
q: What is the amount of initial loan under the scheme?
a: The initial collateral free 'Enterprise Development Loan' is up to Rs 1,00,000 for a tenure of 18 months.

n: PM Vishwakarma
q: When will an applicant become eligible for the second tranche of a loan under the PM Vishwakarma scheme if they have already utilized the first tranche of the loan?
a: The second Loan Tranche of upto Rs. 2,00,000/- will be available to skilled beneficiaries who maintain a standard loan account and have adopted digital transactions in their business or have undergone Advanced Skill Training.

n: PM Vishwakarma
q: Do applicant need to give any collateral to avail loan facility under this scheme?
a: No collateral security is required.

n: PM Vishwakarma
q: What is the rate and amount of interest subvention in the scheme?
a: Concessional rate of interest chargeable from beneficiaries for loans will be fixed at 5%. The interest subvention by the Government of India will be to an extent of 8% and provided upfront to the banks.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: What is the "Part A- Support for First-Time Employees" scheme component?
a: Part A – First Timer Scheme component provides an incentive to assist first-timer employees in navigating their learning curve before they become fully productive with completing their financial literacy course over EPO portal.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: What is UAN?
a: Aadhaar authenticated unique account number allotted to an Employee by Employees’ Provident Fund Organization.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: What is “Electronic Challan cum Return (ECR)”?
a: Online monthly submission of contributions by employers.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: Who is First Timer?
a: Any employee, | - with date of joining in an establishment between 01.08.2025 and 31.07.2027 (both dates inclusive) and | - who was not a contributing member of Employees Provident Fund either with EPFO or Exempted Trust prior to 01.08.2025 and | - their Contribution is received in EPFO or exempted trust for the first time for the wage month August 2025 or thereafter.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: Who is Re-joinee?
a: Any employee, | - with a previous contributory membership of Employees Provident Fund either with EPFO or Exempted Trust andwith a previous contributory membership of Employees Provident Fund either with EPFO or Exempted Trust and | - joins an establishment covered under EPF and MP Act between 01.08.2025 to 31.07.2027.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: What is EPF Wage?
a: “EPF Wage” means the wage on which contribution is paid in terms of Section 6 of the EPF and MP Act,1952.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: What is meant by “Completed Wage Month” for the purpose of the scheme?
a: - Completed Wage Month refers to a full calendar month for which an employer has filed the Electronic Challan-cum-Return (ECR) in respect of the employees. | - For the purposes of calculating benefits under the scheme: | - If the employee joins on or before the 5th day of a month, then that month shall be treated as the first Completed Wage Month. If the employee joins after the 5th day of a month, then the following month be treated as the first Completed Wage Month.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: How employees can register to avail benefits under Part A?
a: There is no registration process for the employees. They will be provided incentive on the basis of ECR filed by their establishment with EPFO.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: Where will the FAT (Facial Authentication Technology) be available for employee UAN aauthentication?
a: The FAT facility provided on UMANG App will be utilized UAN authentication.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: How is the incentive under Part A paid to the First Timer?
a: It is paid in two instalments directly into the Aadhar seeded bank account of the employees.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: How many times incentive will be paid to the Employee during the scheme registration period?
a: It is a one time incentive to all the eligible First Timers.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: What conditions must be met for the Second instalment payment?
a: The First Timer must: | - Complete the Financial Literacy Course, and | - Have worked for 12 completed months in the same establishment and all 12 months of ECR with contributions is filed by the establishment.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: How is the second instalment handled?
a: The second instalment is held in a designated savings or deposit account for a period as specified in future guidelines issued by the Ministry of Labour & Employment.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: What is the “Financial Literacy Course”?
a: A mandatory online course covering personal finance, savings, investments, etc. available on EPFO website.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: What is the maximum incentive payable to a First Timer under Part A?
a: The incentive is equal to one completed month’s EPF wage, subject to a maximum of ₹15,000.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: Is there any base line for the establishment for incentive to the employee?
a: No.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: Is Aadhaar authentication required for eligibility?
a: Yes. Only those with FAT authenticated UAN are eligible for benefits.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: What happens if an employee leaves voluntarily or due to unforeseen circumstances?
a: - If a First Timer leaves the establishment voluntarily or due to unforeseen circumstances before 06 months then they are not eligible for first installment. | - If a First Timer leaves the establishment voluntarily or due to unforeseen circumstances after 06 months but before 12 months then they are not eligible for second installment.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: An employee has a UAN but never contributed to EPFO or any exempted trust, can they be considered a First Timer?
a: - If the employee has a UAN but has never had contributions credited to EPFO or an Exempted Trust before the scheme's start date, and the first contribution is received during the scheme registration period, they are considered a First Timer under the scheme. | - They will becomes eligible for the incentives under Part A, provided all other conditions (biometric Aadhaar authentication, continuous ECRs, completion of Financial Literacy course, etc.) are fulfilled.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: Can an employee who has worked in an exempted establishment earlier qualify as First Timer?
a: If an employee was previously a contributing member in an Exempted Trust and now joins EPFO or vice versa, they cannot qualify as a First Timer.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: What happens if an employee’s bank account is not linked with Aadhaar?
a: Payment of incentives to the employee will be suspended until the bank account is Aadhaar-seeded. However, incentives will continue to accrue. Once Aadhaar seeding is done, all pending payments, including arrears, will be released as per the scheme guidelines.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: How the benefits will be calculated if the few existing employees (i.e. joined before 01.08.2025) leave or retire?
a: The payment of incentive will be done only on the basis of Net employment generated above the baseline as calculated and meeting of threshold criteria.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: Under Part A in death cases if the employee was eligible for 1st instalment or 2nd instalment as the case may be and before the incentive is credited to the Bank account of the employee will the nominee receive the incentive?
a: Yes

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: What if an employee joins after the scheme registration period?
a: Employees who join the establishment after the end of the Scheme registration period are not eligible for incentive benefits under the Scheme. However, for incentive to the establishment such employees will be counted while calculating the Net Additional Employment over and above the baseline and determining threshold fulfillment.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: How the employee can generate UAN?
a: The employee is required to generate UAN using FAT facility as provided on UMANG App and provide the UAN so generated to the employer for filing of ECRs and payment of contributions.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part A- Support for First-Time Employees
q: Whether an employee who has generated their own UAN using the UMANG App with Face Authentication can be linked to the employer’s establishment for verification and hence claim benefits under the scheme?
a: Yes.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: What is the "Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector" scheme component?
a: This component of the scheme is designed to boost employment generation, with a special emphasis on the manufacturing sector. It is an establishment-focused initiative that incentivises the creation of sustained employment across all sectors by providing benefits to eligible establishments for a period of two years. The incentive period for the manufacturing sector is additional 2 years, i.e a total of 4 years.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: What is the incentive Period under the Part B of Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana?
a: Under Part B the incentive period is for 02 years for all sectors and 04 Years for the establishments engaged in Manufacturing Sector.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: How to register in EPFO?
a: Any Establishment can register with EPFO through SPICe+ portal of Ministry of Corporate Affairs or Sharm Suvidha Portal of Ministry of Labour & Employment.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: What details are required for availing benefit of this scheme?
a: The establishment is required to provide details of PAN/TIN, GSTN, PAN linked Bank Account Number.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: How manufacturing sector will be decided?
a: “Manufacturing” means and includes activities as defined in Section 2(72) of Central Goods and Service Tax Act, 2017 as well as mentioned in GSTN certificate of the Establishment.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: How does the scheme address concerns about temporary or unsustainable job creation?
a: Eligibility for Part B requires establishments to sustain new employees for at least six months above the baseline.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: Are exempted establishments included, and how are they monitored?
a: Yes, Exempted establishments under the EPF & MP Act, 1952, must file returns and open UANs through EPFO for all their employees, ensuring compliance and transparency in availing benefits.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: How do exempted establishments register for the scheme?
a: - Filing ECR: They must file the Employee Contribution Report (ECR) without contributions in the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), providing details of all their employees, including First Timers. | - Aadhaar Authentication: For smooth implementation and transparency, exempted establishments are required to open Aadhaar authenticated Universal Account Numbers (UAN) through EPFO for all existing and new employees.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: Whether Existing Establishments Registered with EPFO are Required to Register Anew Under the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana?
a: No. Establishments already registered with the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) are not required to undergo fresh registration under the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana. However, these establishments are required to furnish the following details: | - PAN of the establishment | - GSTN (Goods and Services Tax Number) | - PAN-linked bank account number of the employer

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: How Can a New Establishment Register with EPFO to Avail Benefits Under the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana?
a: No separate process is required. New establishments registering through the Shram Suvidha Portal of the Ministry of Labour & Employment or the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) Portal are automatically allotted an PF Code/EPF number at the time of incorporation or registration.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: To which establishments does the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana apply?
a: The scheme applies to all establishments that are covered under the EPF&MP Act, 1952, including: | Exempted establishments under Section 17 of the Act Subject to fulfilling all applicability conditions laid out in the scheme guidelines.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: What is the baseline for calculating additionality under Part B of the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana?
a: The baseline is the average number of employees considered for an establishment to measure net additional employment for incentive eligibility

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: How is the baseline calculated for Existing Establishments?
a: For establishments registered with EPFO prior to 31.07.2024 and regularly filing ECRs with contributions: | - The baseline = Average number of employees as per ECRs over the 12 months from 01.08.2024 to 31.07.2025. | The baseline will be the average number of employees based on filed Electronic Challan-cum-Returns (ECRs) for the 12 months preceding the scheme start date 01.08.2025. ECRs with contributions must have been filed for all 12 preceding months.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: How is the baseline calculated for establishments registered between 01.08.2024 and 31.07.2025?
a: Baseline will be the average number of employees for the months from the date of registration till 31.07.2025, based on ECRs filed with contributions. | The baseline will be the average number of employees from the date of EPFO registration till 01.08.2025. ECRs with contributions must be filed for all completed months during this period.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: What is the baseline for New Establishments registered between 01.08.2025 and 31.07.2027?
a: The baseline is fixed at 20 employees.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: Are only employees with contributions counted for eligibility?
a: Yes. Only employees for whom contributions are paid through ECR in EPFO or Exempted Trust are counted for additionality, and eligibility calculations.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: Can the baseline change if revised ECRs are filed?
a: No, the baseline remains unchanged once calculated. However, if revised ECRs show a higher number of employees, that higher number will be considered for all scheme purposes.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: What are the key conditions for establishment eligibility under Part B?
a: The establishment must hire and sustain new employees (First Timers and Re-joinees) for at least six months beyond the baseline number of employees and meet the meet the threshold criteria based on baseline numbers.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: What is the threshold criterion for Part B?
a: For establishments with a baseline less than 50 employees: Must add at least 2 employees over baseline. | For establishments with a baseline 50 or more employees: Must add at least 5 employees over baseline.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: What is the upper limit of Threshold criteria in Part B for additional employment generation?
a: There is no upper limit.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: Can an employee with Gross Wages above ₹1 lakh be counted for threshold calculation under Part B?
a: Yes. Employees with gross wages above ₹1 lakh at the time of joining will be counted for calculating threshold/additionality, but no incentive will be paid in respect of them under the scheme.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: Are there any wage limits for employees counted for benefits?
a: Yes. Benefits will be provided in respect of only those First Timers and Re-joinees whose gross wages are up to ₹1 lakh at the time of joining and who complete six months of employment.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: How long is the benefit period for existing and new establishments?
a: - Existing establishments: Benefit period counts for 2 years across all sectors. | - Manufacturing sector: Benefit period counts for 4 years across all sectors. | New establishments: Benefit period counts from the date of EPFO registration for 2 years across all sectors starts and 4 years for manufacturing sector.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: What is the periodicity of incentive payment to the establishment ?
a: Incentive will be paid to the establishment in lumpsum on six monthly basis as per eligibility.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: What happens if an establishment does not meet eligibility criteria during some months?
a: Benefits stop for those months when the criteria are not met but restart once eligibility is regained. However, the overall scheme benefit period remains fixed.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: If an establishment dips below the baseline temporarily, how is the benefit calculated?
a: If the net employee strength falls below the baseline, the establishment will not be eligible for incentive for that period. Once net strength rises above baseline and the threshold condition is met again, benefits resume — but the scheme period remains fixed and no extension is granted for the lost period.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: Can an establishment with the same PAN but different locations avail benefits separately?
a: No, all establishments with the same PAN will be considered as a single entity for scheme purposes.

n: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Part B- Support to Employers with Focus on Manufacturing Sector
q: Are establishments with fewer than 20 employees covered under EPFO eligible for incentives under the scheme?
a: Yes. Establishments registered with EPFO before 01.08.2025 even with employees less than 20 are eligible to avail benefits provided they meet the other criteria of scheme guidelines.

n: Skill Development and Training of Candidates in Technical Textiles
q: What is this scheme?
a: It is a skill development and training program under the National Technical Textiles Mission (NTTM) by the Ministry of Textiles to train 50,000 candidates for the technical textiles industry.

n: Skill Development and Training of Candidates in Technical Textiles
q: Who can benefit from this scheme?
a: The scheme is designed for unskilled workers seeking employment in technical textiles, professionals looking to upskill or reskill, and personnel already engaged in various technical textile applications. It ensures opportunities for a wide range of candidates to enhance their employability.

n: Skill Development and Training of Candidates in Technical Textiles
q: Who can implement the training programs?
a: Training programs can be conducted by recognized training institutes, textile companies, export councils, Centers of Excellence, and public academic institutions under the Ministry of Textiles. Only empaneled implementing agencies approved by the Ministry can execute the programs.

n: Skill Development and Training of Candidates in Technical Textiles
q: What sectors are covered under the scheme?
a: The scheme is implemented in two phases. Phase I includes Agrotech, Buildtech, Geotech, Indutech, Meditech, Mobiltech, and Protech, while Phase II covers Clothtech, Hometech, Oekotech, Sportech, and Packtech. These sectors represent strategically important areas of the technical textiles industry.

n: Skill Development and Training of Candidates in Technical Textiles
q: What are the benefits for trainees?
a: Trainees gain industry-aligned skill training, certification, better employment opportunities, exposure to diverse technical textile applications, and the development of transferable skills. The scheme also enhances adaptability and prepares candidates to meet industry requirements.

n: Skill Development and Training of Candidates in Technical Textiles
q: Is financial support provided?
a: Yes, the Ministry of Textiles shares the training cost with the trainees. The Ministry’s contribution covers candidate mobilization, curriculum development, trainer salaries, teaching aids, equipment, raw materials, assessment costs, and other components as per the Common Norms for Skill Development Schemes.

n: Skill Development and Training of Candidates in Technical Textiles
q: What is the eligibility for applicants?
a: Eligible applicants include Indian citizens of working age, unskilled workers, undergraduates, professionals seeking upskilling or reskilling, and personnel already engaged in technical textile sectors. Specific eligibility may vary based on the type of training program.

n: Skill Development and Training of Candidates in Technical Textiles
q: How are agencies selected?
a: The Skill Development Committee (SDC) under NTTM reviews applications from agencies and shortlists eligible candidates. Empanelment is communicated via an official Ministry order, and only empaneled agencies can conduct the training programs.

n: Skill Development and Training of Candidates in Technical Textiles
q: Is certification provided after training?
a: Yes, upon successful completion of the training, candidates receive industry-recognized certification, which is aligned with market requirements and international curriculum standards. Certification is endorsed by at least five industry partners to ensure credibility.

n: Scheme for ‘Skill Development in ESDM for Digital India’
q: What is the objective of the Scheme?
a: The scheme aims to create a skilled workforce in the Electronics System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM) sector by providing training, certification, and placement-linked support.

n: Scheme for ‘Skill Development in ESDM for Digital India’
q: Who can apply for this scheme?
a: Candidates studying in Class 9 or above, school dropouts (8th pass onwards), ITI certificate holders, diploma holders, undergraduates, graduates, and individuals registered with employment exchanges can apply, subject to course eligibility.

n: Scheme for ‘Skill Development in ESDM for Digital India’
q: What is the minimum age required to apply?
a: The applicant should be at least 17 years old at the time of enrolment.

n: Scheme for ‘Skill Development in ESDM for Digital India’
q: Is Aadhaar mandatory for enrolment?
a: Yes, the applicant should have a valid Aadhaar Number or Aadhaar Enrolment ID and must provide consent for Aadhaar authentication or e-KYC.

n: Scheme for ‘Skill Development in ESDM for Digital India’
q: What kind of training is provided under the scheme?
a: Training is provided in Electronics System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM) sector across NSQF Level 1 to Level 5 courses in both manufacturing and service domains.

n: Scheme for ‘Skill Development in ESDM for Digital India’
q: Is there any fee for the training?
a: Yes, candidates need to pay a Registration-cum-Certification Fee (RCCF). Course fee is subsidised: | - 75% reimbursed for the General category | - 100% reimbursed for SC/ST/EWS candidates (subject to conditions)

n: Scheme for ‘Skill Development in ESDM for Digital India’
q: Will the fee be refunded?
a: Yes, the RCCF and course fee (as applicable) are reimbursed after successful certification and placement, as per scheme norms.

n: Scheme for ‘Skill Development in ESDM for Digital India’

a: The scheme is placement-linked and Training Partners are required to facilitate placement. A minimum of 70% placement is targeted for full reimbursement.

n: Scheme for ‘Skill Development in ESDM for Digital India’

n: Scheme for ‘Skill Development in ESDM for Digital India’

a: Yes, the candidate should maintain at least 70% attendance to be eligible for assessment.

n: Scheme for ‘Skill Development in ESDM for Digital India’

The age of the applicant should not exceed 30 years as of January 1 of the respective year, and they should be Indian citizens.

a: No, a basic understanding of financial markets is desirable but not mandatory.

Interns are entitled to a certain number of leaves per year. Outstation candidates may be provided with unfurnished shared accommodation, subject to availability. Lunch at the SEBI office is provided, and interns receive a certificate of completion of the internship program.

n: Scheme for Economic Empowerment of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes - "Educational Empowerment" Component
q: What is the maximum family income limit for a candidate to be eligible for benefits under this educational empowerment program?
a: The total family income from all sources must be ₹2,50,000/- or less per annum. Income declaration should be obtained from Revenue Officer not below rank of Tehsildar for self-employed families and from employer for employed parents.

n: Scheme for Economic Empowerment of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes - "Educational Empowerment" Component
q: Can I apply for coaching assistance if I am currently studying in the final year of my bachelor's degree program?
a: Yes, students studying in final year of bachelor degree course are eligible for competitive exams requiring graduation qualification. You must be either completed or studying in final year at the time of receiving benefits.

n: Scheme for Economic Empowerment of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes - "Educational Empowerment" Component
q: How many times can I avail the coaching benefits throughout my academic career under this educational support program?
a: Benefits can be availed maximum twice in your lifetime, irrespective of number of chances you may be entitled for any particular competitive examination. You must submit affidavit confirming you have not exceeded this limit.

n: Scheme for Economic Empowerment of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes - "Educational Empowerment" Component
q: What is the monthly stipend amount provided to students who attend coaching institutes outside their home location?
a: Outstation students receive ₹3,000/- per month while local students get ₹1,500/- per month. Stipend is paid till duration of course or for one year, whichever is less, through Direct Benefit Transfer mode.

n: Scheme for Economic Empowerment of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes - "Educational Empowerment" Component
q: Are there any additional financial benefits available for students with disabilities pursuing coaching under this educational support initiative?
a: Students with disabilities having valid disability certificate showing 40% or more disability receive Special Allowance of ₹2,000/- per month. This covers reader allowance, escort allowance, helper allowance in addition to regular stipend.

n: Scheme for Economic Empowerment of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes - "Educational Empowerment" Component
q: Which competitive examinations are covered under the free coaching component of this educational empowerment program for marginalized communities?
a: Coverage includes Union Public Service Commission, Staff Selection Commission, Railway Recruitment Boards, State Public Service Commissions, Banking, Insurance, Public Sector Undertakings, Engineering (Indian Institute of Technology Joint Entrance Examination), Medical (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test), Management (Common Admission Test), Law (Common Law Admission Test), and various eligibility tests.

n: Scheme for Economic Empowerment of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes - "Educational Empowerment" Component
q: When does the online application portal open for receiving applications from eligible candidates throughout the year?
a: The portal remains open twice annually during July and January months for one month each. No offline applications are entertained and all incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.

n: Scheme for Economic Empowerment of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes - "Educational Empowerment" Component
q: What happens if I cannot join my selected coaching institute within the specified time frame after receiving the first installment?
a: If first installment is not paid to selected institute within 6 months, you must return the amount to Government immediately. Second installment will not be eligible and you must submit affidavit confirming this commitment.

n: Scheme for Economic Empowerment of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes - "Educational Empowerment" Component
q: How is the selection process conducted when the number of eligible applications exceeds the available coaching slots?
a: Selection is done in decreasing order of marks obtained in qualifying examinations. Priority is given to students who have qualified preliminary examination at least once for two-stage competitive exams.

n: Scheme for Economic Empowerment of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes - "Educational Empowerment" Component
q: Can I receive coaching assistance for both preliminary and main stages of competitive examinations that are conducted in multiple phases?
a: Yes, you are entitled for free coaching up to two times each for Preliminary and Main examinations. There is no restriction on number of coaching chances for Interview stage if selected.

n: Scheme for Economic Empowerment of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes - "Educational Empowerment" Component
q: What type of income certificate is required if my parents are employed but have additional sources of income?
a: Employed parents must obtain income certificate from their employer and additionally get consolidated certificate from Revenue Officer for any other additional sources of income beyond their employment.

n: Scheme for Economic Empowerment of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes - "Educational Empowerment" Component
q: Is it possible to choose any coaching institute of my preference or are there restrictions on institute selection?
a: You have liberty to choose coaching institute of your preference, but it must be empanelled under Free Coaching Scheme for Scheduled Caste and Other Backward Classes students as maintained by the Ministry.

n: Scheme for Economic Empowerment of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes - "Educational Empowerment" Component
q: What is the maximum course fee limit covered under this educational assistance program for different competitive examination categories?
a: Course fee varies by examination type - Civil Services ₹1,20,000/-, Staff Selection Commission/Railway Recruitment Boards ₹40,000/-, Banking/Insurance/Public Sector Undertakings/Common Law Admission Test ₹50,000/-, Joint Entrance Examination/National Eligibility cum Entrance Test ₹1,20,000/-, Common Admission Test ₹60,000/-, and others as specified in scheme annexure.

n: Scheme for Economic Empowerment of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes - "Educational Empowerment" Component
q: Are students from De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes communities who belong to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes or Other Backward Classes also eligible?
a: Yes, De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes students are eligible irrespective of whether they belong to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes or Other Backward Classes. However, they cannot avail similar benefits from other government schemes simultaneously.

n: ICSSR Senior Fellowship

n: SERB-Technology Translation Award

n: SERB-Technology Translation Award

n: SERB-Technology Translation Award

n: SERB-Technology Translation Award

n: SERB - POWER Fellowship
q: Who is eligible for SERB Power Fellowship?
a: Those who are eligible for SERB Power Fellowship are: | Outstanding women researchers and innovators working in Indian academic institutions and R&D laboratories, holding Ph.D. degrees in any branch of science and engineering. | The nominee should be an active scientist with an excellent record of research performance as an independent investigator or innovator. | The nominee should be in regular service throughout the duration of the Fellowship.

n: SERB - POWER Fellowship
q: Is there any age limit for PI to be eligible for the award?
a: PI should be within 35-55 years at the time of submission of proposal.

n: SERB - POWER Fellowship
q: I am already availing another Fellowship. Am I eligible for SERB Power Fellowship?
a: No, you can avail only one fellowship at a time from government source.

n: SERB - POWER Fellowship
q: Is the Fellowship received under SERB Power Fellowship taxable?
a: Yes, the Fellowship received under SERB Power Fellowship is taxable as per I.T. rules.

n: SERB - POWER Fellowship
q: What are the areas covered under SERB Power Fellowship?
a: All Areas of Science (in the broadest terms) are covered by this Fellowship.

n: SERB - POWER Fellowship
q: What is the nature of support the SERB Power Fellow is entitled for?
a: Nature of Support SERB Power Fellow is entitled for are: | Fellowship of [?]15,000/- per month in addition to regular income. | Research grant of [?] 10 lakhs per annum. | Overhead for the institute.

n: SERB - POWER Fellowship

n: SERB - POWER Fellowship

n: SERB - POWER Fellowship

n: SERB - POWER Fellowship

n: SERB - POWER Fellowship

a: The Grant for the subsequent years is released after receiving the two hard copies of Statement of Expenditure (SE) and Utilization Certificate (UC)in the prescribed format (available in the website). The SE and UC are to be submitted financial year wise i.e. from 01stApril to 31stMarch. For the first year it would be from the Date of Start (DOS) to 31stMarch and subsequently from 01stApril to 31stMarch.

n: SERB - POWER Fellowship

n: SERB - POWER Fellowship

n: SERB - POWER Fellowship

In second step, nominator will click on the link as provided in the mail to find the details of the application. After verification of the details he/she will forward the nomination to SERB.

n: SERB - POWER Fellowship

a: No, SERB POWER Fellowship research grant can not be used for international travel.

n: SERB - POWER Fellowship

n: SERB - POWER Fellowship

n: SERB - POWER Fellowship

n: SERB - POWER Fellowship

n: SERB - POWER Research Grants

n: SERB - POWER Research Grants

a: Applicants from IITs, IISERs, IISC, NITs, Central Universities, and national Labs of Central government Institutions will be considered under level I category. Whereas applicants from state Universities/ Colleges and Private Academic Institutions should apply under Level II category.

n: SERB - POWER Research Grants

n: SERB - POWER Research Grants

n: SERB - POWER Research Grants

a: Yes. Only female Co-Investigator(s) are allowed in SERB- POWER research grant project; provided the work proposed requires complementary expertise for its implementation. A separate budget can also be provided to the female Co-Investigator (s) even if they belong to different institutions.

n: SERB - POWER Research Grants

n: SERB - POWER Research Grants

n: SERB - POWER Research Grants

n: SERB - POWER Research Grants

n: SERB Research Scientist Scheme

n: SERB Research Scientist Scheme

n: SERB Research Scientist Scheme

n: SERB Research Scientist Scheme

n: SERB Research Scientist Scheme

n: SERB Research Scientist Scheme

n: SERB Research Scientist Scheme

n: SERB Research Scientist Scheme

n: SERB Research Scientist Scheme

n: SERB Research Scientist Scheme

n: SERB Research Scientist Scheme

a: The candidates should submit 3 copies of the application printed on both sides of A4 size paper and send to: | Dr. Harish Kumar, Scientist F | Science and Engineering Research Board | 3rd & 4th floor, Block -II, Technology Bhawan, | New Mehrauli Road, New Delhi- 110016, INDIA

n: SERB Research Scientist Scheme

If required, the applicants may be called for personal interviews.

n: Scheme of Financial Assistance to IHMs/FCIs/IITTM/ICI/NCHMCT/PSUs
